items.title: 7.3.1 Causes of the Digital Divide (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of causes of the digital divide (PDF 182-183).

items: Maali rukawatein: bohat se khandan computer, smartphone ya broadband afford nahi kar sakte, khaas taur par taraqqi pazeer mulkon, dehi ilaqon aur kam aamdani walon mein.
Jughrafiyai rukawatein: dehi aur door daraz ilaqon mein aksar internet ka infrastructure nahi hota.
Taleemi rukawatein: technology maujood ho tab bhi taleem aur tarbiyat ke baghair log use istemal nahi kar pate.
Samaji rukawatein: umar, jins aur maazoori rasai par asar dalti hain; buzurg nayi technology kam istemal kar pate, aur kuch ilaqon mein khawateen ko saqafati rukawatein hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Muft laptop scheme kaunsi wajah door karegi aur kaunsi nahi?
blocks.explanation: Yeh aala khareedne ki maali rukawat door karegi, magar ilaqe mein internet ki kami ya istemal ki maharat ki kami nahi.

items: Wajoohat: maali, jughrafiyai, taleemi, samaji rukawatein.
